title: Tranquility Spa Concierge
description: Turned a 20-service spa menu into a guided booking path that attaches each recommendation to the staff's appointment record.
seoDescription: See how a spa concierge narrows 20 services, opens the correct Cal.com calendar, and records the recommendation in Airtable for staff.
timeline: Two-day initial build with later workflow refinements
constraints: Recommendations had to come from an approved service catalog and exact duration matches rather than generic AI knowledge.
Spa staff had to update services and run visits through Airtable without editing the concierge.
The recommended service had to remain attached to the appointment through the entire visit.
problem: A crowded spa menu left visitors choosing by unfamiliar service names. When someone booked, staff received no record of the guidance that led there.
solution: Built a concierge that narrows a 20-service catalog by goal and duration, then stores the recommendation on the Airtable appointment staff use.
result: The working prototype carried the recommended service from the guest conversation into the staff visit record.
One Airtable catalog controlled 20 services mapped to six Cal.com booking groups.
Typebot's free plan limited the prototype to 200 chats per month. The Airtable and Make workflows can remain if Typebot is replaced.
deliveryHighlights: A complete spa website where guests can open a floating concierge while browsing services.
An Airtable workspace where staff prepare for visits, record outcomes, and update services.
A working handoff from DeepSeek's recommendation to Cal.com booking and Tally intake.
